character.concept: A careful battlefield controller who keeps meticulous notes on every spell interaction and protects younger adventurers like a stern tutor.
An oathbound knight of a ruined border keep who carries the guilt of failing to save their first squire.
A quiet tracker focused on monster hunting, survival skills, and practical gear rather than heroics.
A street performer with unstable magic who wants to entertain crowds but keeps accidentally causing arcane accidents.
A veteran temple healer whose magic is practical, disciplined, and shaped by years of plague relief work.
A nimble infiltrator with a strict moral code, strong social skills, and a habit of leaving mocking calling cards behind.

npc.concept: A town herbalist whose ledger suggests they are supplying both the local guard and a smuggling ring.
A village teacher pushed into leadership during a crisis, practical and compassionate but clearly exhausted.

enemy.concept: A goblin fire-mage raider who relies on mobility, reckless spell use, and intimidation.
A cult enforcer bound to infernal chains, designed to pressure the party with control effects and dark charisma.
